lemma upSingletProj_comp_repLorentzGroup (i : Fin 3) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    (upSingletProj i).comp (repLorentzGroup Λ)
      = (UpSinglet.repLorentzGroup Λ).comp (upSingletProj i)

declarations.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.downSingletProj_comp_repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The down-type-quark-singlet projection intertwines the total Lorentz action with the
down-type quark singlet's own.
declarations.statement:
lemma downSingletProj_comp_repLorentzGroup (i : Fin 3) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) :
    (downSingletProj i).comp (repLorentzGroup Λ)
      = (DownSinglet.repLorentzGroup Λ).comp (downSingletProj i)

declarations.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.sum_incl_proj
declarations.doc:
The identity on the total fermionic target space is the sum, over the five species and
the three generations, of the inclusion after the projection.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_incl_proj (v : FermionSpace) :
    (∑ i, leptonDoubletIncl i (leptonDoubletProj i v))
      + (∑ i, leptonSingletIncl i (leptonSingletProj i v))
      + (∑ i, quarkDoubletIncl i (quarkDoubletProj i v))
      + (∑ i, upSingletIncl i (upSingletProj i v))
      + (∑ i, downSingletIncl i (downSingletProj i v)) = v

declarations.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.sum_conj_incl_proj
declarations.doc:
The conjugate form of `sum_incl_proj`: conjugation leaves the underlying additive
group and the underlying maps alone.
declarations.statement:
lemma sum_conj_incl_proj (v : ConjModule FermionSpace) :
    (∑ i, ConjModule.map (leptonDoubletIncl i)
        (ConjModule.map (leptonDoubletProj i) v))
      + (∑ i, ConjModule.map (leptonSingletIncl i)
          (ConjModule.map (leptonSingletProj i) v))
      + (∑ i, ConjModule.map (quarkDoubletIncl i)
          (ConjModule.map (quarkDoubletProj i) v))
      + (∑ i, ConjModule.map (upSingletIncl i)
          (ConjModule.map (upSingletProj i) v))
      + (∑ i, ConjModule.map (downSingletIncl i)
          (ConjModule.map (downSingletProj i) v)) = v

declarations.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.dual_eq_sum
declarations.doc:
Every covector on the total fermionic target space is the sum, over the five species
and the three generations, of its restriction to that species and generation pulled back
along the corresponding projection.
declarations.statement:
lemma dual_eq_sum (φ : Module.Dual ℂ FermionSpace) :
    φ = (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (leptonDoubletProj i)
          (Module.Dual.transpose (leptonDoubletIncl i) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (leptonSingletProj i)
          (Module.Dual.transpose (leptonSingletIncl i) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (quarkDoubletProj i)
          (Module.Dual.transpose (quarkDoubletIncl i) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (upSingletProj i)
          (Module.Dual.transpose (upSingletIncl i) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (downSingletProj i)
          (Module.Dual.transpose (downSingletIncl i) φ))

declarations.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.speciesDual
declarations.doc:
The covectors on the total fermionic target space that are pulled back from a single
species and generation.
declarations.statement: def speciesDual : Set (Module.Dual ℂ FermionSpace)

declarations.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.span_speciesDual_eq_top
declarations.doc:
The covectors pulled back from the individual species and generations span every
covector on the total fermionic target space. This is what lets an adjoin taken over the
species covectors reach an adjoin taken over all of them.
declarations.statement: lemma span_speciesDual_eq_top : Submodule.span ℂ speciesDual = ⊤

declarations.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.conjDual_eq_sum
declarations.doc:
The conjugate form of `dual_eq_sum`: every covector on the conjugate of the total
fermionic target space is the sum of the covectors pulled back from the species and
generations.
declarations.statement:
lemma conjDual_eq_sum (φ : Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule FermionSpace)) :
    φ = (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (leptonDoubletProj i))
          (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (leptonDoubletIncl i)) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (leptonSingletProj i))
          (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (leptonSingletIncl i)) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (quarkDoubletProj i))
          (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (quarkDoubletIncl i)) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (upSingletProj i))
          (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (upSingletIncl i)) φ))
      + (∑ i, Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (downSingletProj i))
          (Module.Dual.transpose (ConjModule.map (downSingletIncl i)) φ))

declarations.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.speciesConjDual
declarations.doc:
The covectors on the conjugate of the total fermionic target space that are pulled
back from a single species and generation.
declarations.statement: def speciesConjDual : Set (Module.Dual ℂ (ConjModule FermionSpace))

declarations.name: StandardModel.FermionSpace.span_speciesConjDual_eq_top
declarations.doc:
The conjugate covectors pulled back from the individual species and generations span
every covector on the conjugate of the total fermionic target space.
declarations.statement: lemma span_speciesConjDual_eq_top : Submodule.span ℂ speciesConjDual = ⊤

modules.title: Lepton doublets
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The Standard Model lepton doublet is a left-handed Weyl spinor in the `(1, 2)_{-3}`
representation. Here charges are normalized as `6Y`, so `-3` is the usual hypercharge
`Y = -1/2`.

The lepton doublet is the datum `StandardModel.Model.leptonDoublet`,
`(.L, .singlet, .fund, -3)`, of the Standard Model table. `LeptonDoubletV` is its target
space, a left-handed Weyl spinor tensored with the weak coordinates, and every action on
it — Lorentz, global gauge, jet gauge — is the one the general theory derives from the
datum. The hand-built definitions are kept in comments.

The gauge action is computed on a basis, used to identify its kernel, and descended to
each supported global form of the Standard Model gauge group.

## ii. Key results

- `LeptonDoubletV` : the target space of the `(1, 2)_{-3}` multiplet.
- `repLorentzGroup` : the left-handed Lorentz action.
- `repGaugeGroupI` : the action of the unquotiented gauge group.
- `repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis` : the gauge action in the spinor–weak basis.
- `mem_repGaugeGroupI_ker_iff_eq` : the kernel of the full-group action.
- `gaugeGroup_subgroup_ℤ₆_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI` : triviality of the central `ℤ₆`.
- `repGaugeGroup` : the action descended to every supported gauge-group quotient.
- `repJetGaugeGroupI` : the action of the jet gauge group on the jets of the doublet.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The lepton-doublet space
- B. The basis
- C. Lorentz action
- D. Gauge action
- E. Kernel of the gauge action
- F. Descent to quotient gauge groups
- G. Jet gauge action
- H. Component transformation laws
- I. The gauge weight of the LeptonDoubletV components
- J. The boost weight of the LeptonDoubletV components

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text:
## A. The lepton-doublet space

The Weyl factor carries the left-handed Lorentz index, while the functions on `Fin 2`
carry the weak index.
## B. The basis

## C. Lorentz action

The Lorentz group acts on the left-handed Weyl factor and leaves the weak index fixed.

## D. Gauge action

The colour factor acts trivially, while `SU(2)` acts on the weak index. The `U(1)` action
is `star z ^ 3`; since `z` is unitary, `star z = z⁻¹`, so this represents charge `-3`.

The tensor and basis formulas below expose the coefficients used to compare actions and
compute the kernel.

## E. Kernel of the gauge action

An element acts trivially when its weak action is scalar and that scalar cancels its
`U(1)` phase. Its colour component is unrestricted because the lepton doublet is an
`SU(3)` singlet.

## F. Descent to quotient gauge groups

A representation descends through a quotient when the quotient subgroup lies in its
kernel. For the central `ℤ₆`, the weak central phase and charge `-3` phase combine to a
sixth power and therefore act trivially.

## G. Jet gauge action

The `(1, 2)_{-3}` representation extends to jets: the `SU(2)` power-series matrix of a
jet of gauge transformations, scaled by the hypercharge power series `star u ^ 3`, acts
`SpaceTimeAlgebra`-linearly on the weak factor. On jets of constant gauge transformations the
action reduces to the global gauge action. Both are the general theory's, for the datum.

## H. Component transformation laws

The basis of `LeptonDoubletV` splits as a left-handed Weyl index and a weak-isospin index.
The Lorentz group moves only the first, the gauge group only the second (up to the
hypercharge scalar), so both actions are recorded as a single sum over the index they move.
Dualising inverts and transposes the coefficient matrix, and conjugating stars it; the four
combinations below are what a component of a lepton-doublet symbol needs.

## I. The gauge weight of the LeptonDoubletV components

The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `LeptonDoubletV`; the weights are recorded by
`LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight`, and pass to the dual and conjugate-dual coordinate
functionals with the expected signs.
## J. The boost weight of the LeptonDoubletV components

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV
declarations.doc:
The target vector space of one Standard Model lepton doublet: the target space of the
datum `StandardModel.Model.leptonDoublet`, a left-handed Weyl spinor tensored with the
weak coordinates. It carries the `(1, 2)_{-3}` representation of the gauge group.
declarations.statement: abbrev LeptonDoubletV : Type

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.basis
declarations.doc:
A basis on the lepton doublets: the Weyl basis tensored with the coordinate basis of
the weak index.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def basis : Module.Basis (Fin 2 × Fin 2) ℂ LeptonDoubletV

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.basis_apply
declarations.doc: The lepton-doublet basis vector as an explicit spinor–weak tensor.
declarations.statement:
lemma basis_apply (k j : Fin 2) :
    basis (k, j) = Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.basis k ⊗ₜ[ℂ] Pi.single j 1

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The left-handed Lorentz representation on lepton doublets: the Lorentz action the
general theory derives from the datum.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def repLorentzGroup : Representation ℂ (SL(2,ℂ)) LeptonDoubletV

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_tmul
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on a pure spinor–weak tensor: the left-handed action on the Weyl
factor, the weak index untouched.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_tmul (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (s : Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl) (v : Fin 2 → ℂ) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (s ⊗ₜ v) = Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.rep Λ s ⊗ₜ v

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.doubletMatrix
declarations.doc:
The `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-valued weak matrix of the jet gauge action on the lepton doublet: the
matrix of jets by which a gauge jet acts on the datum.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def doubletMatrix (U : JetGaugeGroupI) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.doubletMatrix_eq
declarations.doc:
The weak matrix of a gauge jet is its `SU(2)` matrix carrying the `-3` hypercharge
phase `(star u) ^ 3`.
declarations.statement:
lemma doubletMatrix_eq (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    doubletMatrix U = ((star ((U.2.2 : unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) : SpaceTimeAlgebra)) ^ 3) •
      ((U.2.1 : specialUnitaryGroup (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra) : Matrix (Fin 2)
          (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.doubletMatrix_ofConstant_map_constantCoeff
declarations.doc:
The constant term of the weak matrix of a constant gauge jet: the `SU(2)` matrix of
the gauge transformation carrying its `-3` hypercharge phase.
declarations.statement:
lemma doubletMatrix_ofConstant_map_constantCoeff (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    (doubletMatrix (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g)).map (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra → ℂ)
      = (star g.toU1.1 ^ 3) • g.toSU2.1

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.doubletMatrix_ofConstant
declarations.doc: The weak matrix of a constant gauge jet is constant.
declarations.statement:
lemma doubletMatrix_ofConstant (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    doubletMatrix (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g)
      = ((doubletMatrix (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g)).map
          (constantCoeff : SpaceTimeAlgebra → ℂ)).map
          (MvPowerSeries.C : ℂ → SpaceTimeAlgebra)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI
declarations.doc:
The `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the unquotiented Standard Model gauge group: the global
action the general theory derives from the datum, the constant term of the jet action.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def repGaugeGroupI : Representation ℂ GaugeGroupI LeptonDoubletV

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_tmul
declarations.doc:
The gauge action on a pure spinor–weak tensor: the `SU(2)` matrix, scaled by the
hypercharge factor, acts on the weak index.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_tmul (g : GaugeGroupI) (v : Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl) (w : Fin 2 → ℂ) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (v ⊗ₜ w) = v ⊗ₜ ((star g.toU1.1 ^ 3) • g.toSU2.1).mulVec w

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge action on the lepton-doublet basis: the spinor index is inert and the weak
index transforms by the `SU(2)` matrix, scaled by the hypercharge factor.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis j) =
      ∑ w, (star g.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g.toSU2.1 w j.2) • basis (j.1, w)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_tmul_basis_eq_sum
declarations.doc: Expands the lepton-doublet gauge action on a tensor-product basis vector.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_tmul_basis_eq_sum (g : GaugeGroupI) (k j : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis (k, j)) =
      ∑ j' : Fin 2, (star g.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g.toSU2.1 j' j) • basis (k, j')

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_eq_iff_mul_eq
declarations.doc:
Two gauge elements induce the same action exactly when their weak-basis coefficients
agree.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_eq_iff_mul_eq {g₁ g₂ : GaugeGroupI} :
    repGaugeGroupI g₁ = repGaugeGroupI g₂ ↔ ∀ j j',
    star g₁.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g₁.toSU2.1 j' j =
      star g₂.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g₂.toSU2.1 j' j

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.mem_repGaugeGroupI_ker_iff_eq
declarations.doc: Characterizes the full-group elements acting trivially on the lepton doublet.
declarations.statement:
lemma mem_repGaugeGroupI_ker_iff_eq {g : GaugeGroupI} :
    g ∈ repGaugeGroupI.ker ↔ ∃ a : ℂ, g.toSU2.1 = a • 1 ∧
      a * star g.toU1.1 ^ 3 = 1

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeGroup_subgroup_ℤ₆_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI
declarations.doc: The central `ℤ₆` subgroup acts trivially on `(1, 2)_{-3}`.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeGroup_subgroup_ℤ₆_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI :
    GaugeGroupQuot.subgroup .ℤ₆ ≤ repGaugeGroupI.ker

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI
declarations.doc: Every supported quotient subgroup acts trivially on the lepton doublet.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI (Q : GaugeGroupQuot) :
    Q.subgroup ≤ repGaugeGroupI.ker

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroup
declarations.doc:
The `(1, 2)_{-3}` representation for every supported global form of the
Standard Model gauge group.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def repGaugeGroup : (Q : GaugeGroupQuot) →
    Representation ℂ (GaugeGroup Q) LeptonDoubletV

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repJetGaugeGroupI
declarations.doc:
The `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the jet gauge group on the jet space of the lepton
doublet: the jet action the general theory derives from the datum.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def repJetGaugeGroupI :
    Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonDoubletV)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repJetGaugeGroupI_smul
declarations.doc:
**The jet gauge action on the jets of the lepton doublet is fibrewise**: it commutes
with multiplication by scalar jets.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_smul (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonDoubletV) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (χ • z) = χ • repJetGaugeGroupI U z

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant
declarations.doc:
On jets of constant gauge transformations the jet action reduces to the global
gauge action on the fibre: the `(1, 2)_{-3}` action on the lepton-doublet factor, and
the trivial action on the jet ring.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (repGaugeGroupI g)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the lepton-doublet basis: the weak index is inert and the
spinor index transforms by the matrix itself.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis j) = ∑ β, Λ.1 β j.1 • basis (β, j.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The lepton-doublet coordinate functionals transform contragrediently, by the
inverse matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.dual Λ (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, (Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β • basis.dualBasis (β, j.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the conjugate lepton-doublet basis: the coefficients are the
conjugates of those of the lepton-doublet action.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj Λ ((Basis.conj basis) j)
      = ∑ β, star (Λ.1 β j.1) • (Basis.conj basis) (β, j.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The conjugate lepton-doublet coordinate functionals transform by the entrywise
conjugate of the inverse matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj.dual Λ ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ β, star ((Λ⁻¹).1 j.1 β) • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (β, j.2)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_neg_one
declarations.doc:
**The centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts on the lepton-doublet space by `-1`**: the value space carries a
single Weyl-spinor index, and `-1` is not the identity on a half-integer spin.
declarations.statement: lemma repLorentzGroup_neg_one : repLorentzGroup (-1) = -LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one
declarations.doc:
The centre acts on the conjugate lepton-doublet space by `-1` as well: conjugation does not
move a real sign.
declarations.statement: lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one : repLorentzGroup.conj (-1) = -LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The lepton-doublet coordinate functionals carry the contragredient gauge action: the
hypercharge and `SU(2)` factors of the inverse group element, transposed.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.dual g (basis.dualBasis j) =
      ∑ w, (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 3 * (g⁻¹).toSU2.1 j.2 w) • basis.dualBasis (j.1, w)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge action on the conjugate lepton-doublet basis: the coefficients of the
lepton-doublet action, conjugated.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj g ((Basis.conj basis) j) =
      ∑ w, star (star g.toU1.1 ^ 3 * g.toSU2.1 w j.2) • (Basis.conj basis) (j.1, w)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The conjugate lepton-doublet coordinate functionals carry the conjugate of the
contragredient gauge action.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual g ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis j) =
      ∑ w, star (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 3 * (g⁻¹).toSU2.1 j.2 w) •
        (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis (j.1, w)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight
declarations.doc:
The gauge weight of the lepton-doublet basis: the isospin weight and hypercharge
`-3`.
declarations.statement: def LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) : GaugeWeight

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `LeptonDoubletV`, with the weights
`LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight`.
declarations.statement:
lemma LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI (gaugeTorusGen i) (LeptonDoubletV.basis j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        LeptonDoubletV.basis j

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
declarations.doc:
The dual action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals of
`LeptonDoubletV`: the weights are negated.
declarations.statement:
lemma LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI.dual (gaugeTorusGen i) (LeptonDoubletV.basis.coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ (-(GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight j) i))) •
        LeptonDoubletV.basis.coord j

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
declarations.doc:
The dual of the conjugate action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals
of the conjugate of `LeptonDoubletV`: the two negations cancel and the weights are those of
the value space.
declarations.statement:
lemma LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    LeptonDoubletV.repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual (gaugeTorusGen i)
      (((Basis.conj LeptonDoubletV.basis)).coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonDoubletV.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        ((Basis.conj LeptonDoubletV.basis)).coord j

declarations.name: StandardModel.leptonDoublet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis
declarations.doc: The lepton-doublet basis diagonalises the `z`-boost: the isospin index is inert.
declarations.statement:
lemma leptonDoublet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (j : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup (SL2C.boostAxis 2 t ht) (LeptonDoubletV.basis j)
      = ((t : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (weylWeight j.1) • LeptonDoubletV.basis j

modules.title: The infinitesimal gauge action on the lepton doublet
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The infinitesimal `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the gauge algebra on the lepton doublet: the
weak part of the algebra element acts on the weak index and the hypercharge part scales,
both through the physicists' factor of `i`, matching the group action
`(star u) ^ 3 • U₂` infinitesimally. Every definition is the one the general theory
derives from the table's datum `StandardModel.Model.leptonDoublet`; the compatibility with
the jet gauge action —
`LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf` — is the generic
`LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.isInfinitesimalActionOf`. The hand-built definitions and the
hand-written proof are kept in comments.

## ii. Key results

- `weakEnd` : the endomorphism of the lepton doublet defined by a `2 × 2` matrix on the
  weak index.
- `gaugeAlgebraAction` : the infinitesimal `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the gauge algebra.
- `isInfinitesimalActionOf` : the gauge-algebra action is the infinitesimal action
  underlying the jet gauge action `repJetGaugeGroupI`.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The action of the gauge algebra
- B. The infinitesimal action underlies the jet gauge action
- C. The gauge action commutes with the Lorentz action

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text: ## A. The action of the gauge algebra

## B. The infinitesimal action underlies the jet gauge action

The `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the gauge algebra is the infinitesimal action underlying the
jet gauge action, in the sense of `LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf`: this is the
generic `LocalGaugeData.MatrixRep.isInfinitesimalActionOf`, proved once for every matrix
representation of jets. The jet action matrix and the base-point Taylor coefficients of
the jet action are likewise those of the datum.
## C. The gauge action commutes with the Lorentz action

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd
declarations.doc:
The endomorphism of the lepton doublet defined by a `2 × 2` complex matrix acting on
the weak index, with the Weyl factor untouched.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def weakEnd (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    LeptonDoubletV →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonDoubletV

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_tmul
declarations.doc:
The weak endomorphism on a pure spinor–weak tensor: the matrix acts on the weak
coordinates.
declarations.statement:
lemma weakEnd_tmul (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (s : Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl)
    (v : Fin 2 → ℂ) :
    weakEnd A (s ⊗ₜ v) = s ⊗ₜ A.mulVec v

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_add
declarations.statement:
lemma weakEnd_add (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    weakEnd (A + B) = weakEnd A + weakEnd B

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_smul
declarations.statement:
lemma weakEnd_smul (z : ℂ) (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    weakEnd (z • A) = z • weakEnd A

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_zero
declarations.statement: lemma weakEnd_zero : weakEnd 0 = 0

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_neg
declarations.statement: lemma weakEnd_neg (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) : weakEnd (-A) = -weakEnd A

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_multiset_sum
declarations.statement:
lemma weakEnd_multiset_sum (m : Multiset (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) :
    weakEnd m.sum = (m.map weakEnd).sum

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_mul
declarations.doc: The weak endomorphisms compose through matrix multiplication.
declarations.statement:
lemma weakEnd_mul (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    weakEnd (A * B) = weakEnd A ∘ₗ weakEnd B

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.weakEnd_one
declarations.doc: The weak endomorphism of the identity matrix is the identity.
declarations.statement: lemma weakEnd_one : weakEnd 1 = LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.actionMatrix
declarations.doc:
The matrix of the infinitesimal `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of a gauge algebra element on
the weak index: the action matrix of the datum.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def actionMatrix (c : GaugeAlgebra) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.actionMatrix_eq
declarations.doc:
The action matrix is `i` times the weak part, shifted by `i` times `-3` the
hypercharge.
declarations.statement:
lemma actionMatrix_eq (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    actionMatrix c = Complex.I • (c.toSU2Matrix - ((3 : ℂ) • c.toU1Value) • 1)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction
declarations.doc:
**The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra on the lepton doublet**: the
derivative of the `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the gauge group, real-linear in the
algebra slot and complex-linear in the value slot — the form consumed by the
covariant derivative `GaugeAlgebraRealization.covDerivIter` and by
`LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf`. It is the action the general theory derives
from the datum.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gaugeAlgebraAction :
    GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] LeptonDoubletV →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonDoubletV

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction_apply
declarations.doc: The gauge algebra acts by the weak endomorphism of its action matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_apply (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    gaugeAlgebraAction c = weakEnd (actionMatrix c)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.jetActionMatrix
declarations.doc:
The jet-valued matrix of the infinitesimal `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of a jet of gauge
algebra elements: the jet action matrix of the datum.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def jetActionMatrix (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) SpaceTimeAlgebra

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.jetActionMatrix_eq
declarations.doc:
The jet action matrix is `i` times the weak part, shifted by `i` times `-3` the
hypercharge.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetActionMatrix_eq (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    jetActionMatrix a = Complex.I • (a.toSU2Matrix - ((3 : ℂ) • a.toU1Value) • 1)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.jetActionMatrix_map_cc_foldl
declarations.doc:
The base-point Taylor coefficients of the jet action matrix are the action matrices
of the base-point Taylor coefficients.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetActionMatrix_map_cc_foldl (p : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) (a : JetGaugeAlgebra) :
    ((jetActionMatrix a).map fun f =>
        constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv p f))
      = actionMatrix (JetGaugeAlgebra.eval (JetGaugeAlgebra.iteratedDeriv p a))

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repCoeff_eq
declarations.doc:
**The base-point Taylor coefficients of the jet gauge action** on the lepton
doublet are the weak endomorphisms of the base-point Taylor coefficients of the
weak matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repCoeff_eq (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U x
      = weakEnd ((doubletMatrix U).map fun f =>
          constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x f))

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one
declarations.doc:
At the base point, a gauge jet with trivial value acts trivially: the zeroth
Taylor coefficient of the jet gauge action is the identity.
declarations.statement:
lemma repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one {U : JetGaugeGroupI} (hU : U.eval = 1) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U 0 = LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.isInfinitesimalActionOf
declarations.doc:
**The `(1, 2)_{-3}` action of the gauge algebra is the infinitesimal action
underlying the jet gauge action on the lepton doublet**: its base-point Taylor
coefficients obey the Maurer–Cartan Leibniz law and intertwine the action with the
adjoint transports. This is the generic statement for the datum's matrix
representation.
declarations.statement:
lemma isInfinitesimalActionOf :
    localGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf gaugeAlgebraAction repJetGaugeGroupI

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The infinitesimal gauge action on the lepton doublet acts on the weak factor, the
Lorentz action on the Weyl factor, so the two commute.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (v : LeptonDoubletV) :
    LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction c (LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup Λ v) =
      LeptonDoubletV.repLorentzGroup Λ (LeptonDoubletV.gaugeAlgebraAction c v)

modules.title: Charged-lepton singlets
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The Standard Model charged-lepton singlet is a right-handed Weyl spinor in the `(1, 1)_{-6}`
representation. Here charges are normalized as `6Y`, so `-6` is the usual hypercharge
`Y = -1`.

`LeptonSinglet` is the target vector space of one charged-lepton singlet. Its only index is
the Lorentz index carried by the Weyl spinor.

The Lorentz and gauge actions are first defined separately. The gauge action is then computed
on an arbitrary spinor, used to identify its kernel, and descended to each supported global
form of the Standard Model gauge group.

## ii. Key results

- `LeptonSinglet` : the target space of the `(1, 1)_{-6}` multiplet.
- `repLorentzGroup` : the right-handed Lorentz action.
- `repGaugeGroupI` : the action of the unquotiented gauge group.
- `repGaugeGroupI_apply` : the gauge action on a spinor.
- `mem_repGaugeGroupI_ker_iff_eq` : the kernel of the full-group action.
- `gaugeGroup_subgroup_ℤ₆_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI` : triviality of the central `ℤ₆`.
- `repGaugeGroup` : the action descended to every supported gauge-group quotient.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The charged-lepton-singlet space
- B. Linear structure
  - B.1. The basis of the charged-lepton-singlet space
- C. Lorentz action
- D. Global Gauge action
- E. Kernel of the gauge action
- F. Descent to quotient gauge groups
- G. The representation of the jet gauge group
- H. The gauge weight of the LeptonSinglet components
- I. The boost weight of the LeptonSinglet components

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text:
## A. The charged-lepton-singlet space

The Weyl spinor carries the right-handed Lorentz index, and it is the whole of the multiplet:
a charged-lepton singlet has no colour index and no weak-isospin index.

## B. Linear structure

The wrapper distinguishes charged-lepton singlets from other isomorphic vector spaces.
The following equivalences transfer the linear structure of the Weyl-spinor space and expose
that model when defining representations.
### B.1. The basis of the charged-lepton-singlet space

## C. Lorentz action

The Lorentz group acts through the right-handed Weyl representation, transported along the
identification of a charged-lepton singlet with its spinor.

## D. Global Gauge action

The colour and weak factors act trivially, so the gauge group acts only through hypercharge.
The `U(1)` action is `star z ^ 6`; since `z` is unitary, `star z = z⁻¹`, so this represents
charge `-6`.

The formulas below expose the scalar used to compare actions and compute the kernel.

## E. Kernel of the gauge action

An element acts trivially exactly when its hypercharge scalar is one. Its colour and weak
components are unrestricted, since neither appears in the action.

## F. Descent to quotient gauge groups

A representation descends through a quotient when the quotient subgroup lies in its kernel.
The `U(1)` component of a central element is a sixth root of unity, so conjugating and raising
to the sixth power gives one, and charge `-6` therefore acts trivially.

## G. The representation of the jet gauge group

The charged-lepton singlet carries no colour or weak index, so a jet of gauge
transformations acts on its jets purely through the hypercharge power series
`(star u) ^ 6`, multiplying the jet-ring factor and leaving the Weyl factor untouched.

## H. The gauge weight of the LeptonSinglet components

The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `LeptonSinglet`; the weights are recorded by
`LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight`, and pass to the dual and conjugate-dual coordinate
functionals with the expected signs.
## I. The boost weight of the LeptonSinglet components

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.basis
declarations.doc: A basis on the charged-lepton singlets.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def basis : Module.Basis (Fin 2) ℂ LeptonSinglet
instance : Module.Finite ℂ LeptonSinglet
instance : Module.Free ℂ LeptonSinglet

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the lepton-singlet basis: the right-handed Weyl
action by the entrywise conjugate matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup Λ (basis α) = ∑ β, star (Λ.1 β α) • basis β

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The lepton jet coordinates transform contragrediently, by the entrywise
conjugate of the inverse matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.dual Λ (basis.dualBasis α) =
      ∑ β, star ((Λ⁻¹).1 α β) • basis.dualBasis β

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The Lorentz action on the conjugate lepton basis: the coefficients are the
conjugates of those of the lepton action, that is, the matrix itself.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_apply_basis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj Λ ((Basis.conj basis) α) = ∑ β, Λ.1 β α • (Basis.conj basis) β

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc: The conjugate lepton jet coordinates transform by the inverse matrix.
declarations.statement:
lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_dual_dualBasis (Λ : SL(2,ℂ)) (α : Fin 2) :
    repLorentzGroup.conj.dual Λ ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis α) =
      ∑ β, (Λ⁻¹).1 α β • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis β

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_neg_one
declarations.doc:
**The centre of `SL(2,ℂ)` acts on the charged-lepton-singlet space by `-1`**: the value
space carries a single Weyl-spinor index, and `-1` is not the identity on a half-integer
spin.
declarations.statement: lemma repLorentzGroup_neg_one : repLorentzGroup (-1) = -LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one
declarations.doc:
The centre acts on the conjugate charged-lepton-singlet space by `-1` as well:
conjugation does not move a real sign.
declarations.statement: lemma repLorentzGroup_conj_neg_one : repLorentzGroup.conj (-1) = -LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge action on the lepton-singlet basis: multiplication by the hypercharge
scalar, the colour and weak factors acting trivially.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (α : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI g (basis α) = (star g.toU1.1 ^ 6 : ℂ) • basis α

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The lepton-singlet coordinate functionals carry the contragredient gauge action: the
hypercharge scalar of the inverse group element.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (α : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.dual g (basis.dualBasis α) =
      (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 6 : ℂ) • basis.dualBasis α

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge action on the conjugate lepton-singlet basis: the hypercharge scalar,
conjugated.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_apply_basis (g : GaugeGroupI) (α : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj g ((Basis.conj basis) α) =
      star (star g.toU1.1 ^ 6 : ℂ) • (Basis.conj basis) α

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis
declarations.doc:
The conjugate lepton-singlet coordinate functionals carry the conjugate of the
contragredient gauge action.
declarations.statement:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_dualBasis (g : GaugeGroupI) (α : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual g ((Basis.conj basis).dualBasis α) =
      star (star (g⁻¹).toU1.1 ^ 6 : ℂ) • (Basis.conj basis).dualBasis α

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI
declarations.doc:
The `(1, 1)_{-6}` action of the jet gauge group on the jet space of the charged-lepton
singlet: multiplication of the jet-ring factor by the hypercharge power series
`(star u) ^ 6`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def repJetGaugeGroupI :
    Representation ℂ JetGaugeGroupI (SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonSinglet)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI_tmul
declarations.doc:
The jet gauge action on a pure tensor of the jet space of the charged-lepton
singlet.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_tmul (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (f : SpaceTimeAlgebra) (ψ : LeptonSinglet) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (f ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ψ)
      = ((star ((U.2.2 : unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) : SpaceTimeAlgebra)) ^ 6 * f) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] ψ

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI_smul
declarations.doc:
**The jet gauge action on the jets of the charged-lepton singlet is fibrewise**: it
commutes with multiplication by scalar jets.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_smul (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (χ : SpaceTimeAlgebra)
    (z : SpaceTimeAlgebra ⊗[ℂ] LeptonSinglet) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U (χ • z) = χ • repJetGaugeGroupI U z

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant
declarations.doc:
On jets of constant gauge transformations the jet action reduces to the global
gauge action on the fibre: the `(1, 1)_{-6}` action on the lepton-singlet factor, and
the trivial action on the jet ring.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_ofConstant (g : GaugeGroupI) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI (JetGaugeGroupI.ofConstant g) =
      TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (repGaugeGroupI g)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight
declarations.doc: The gauge weight of the lepton-singlet basis: hypercharge `-6`.
declarations.statement: def LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight (_ : Fin 2) : GaugeWeight

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis
declarations.doc:
The gauge torus acts diagonally on the basis of `LeptonSinglet`, with the weights
`LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight`.
declarations.statement:
lemma LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_gaugeTorusGen_basis (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2) :
    LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI (gaugeTorusGen i) (LeptonSinglet.basis j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        LeptonSinglet.basis j

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
declarations.doc:
The dual action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals of
`LeptonSinglet`: the weights are negated.
declarations.statement:
lemma LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2) :
    LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI.dual (gaugeTorusGen i) (LeptonSinglet.basis.coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ (-(GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i))) •
        LeptonSinglet.basis.coord j

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord
declarations.doc:
The dual of the conjugate action of the gauge torus on the coordinate functionals
of the conjugate of `LeptonSinglet`: the two negations cancel and the weights are those of
the value space.
declarations.statement:
lemma LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_conj_dual_gaugeTorusGen_coord (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 2) :
    LeptonSinglet.repGaugeGroupI.conj.dual (gaugeTorusGen i)
      (((Basis.conj LeptonSinglet.basis)).coord j)
      = ((expI : ℂ) ^ GaugeWeight.coord (LeptonSinglet.valueGaugeWeight j) i) •
        ((Basis.conj LeptonSinglet.basis)).coord j

declarations.name: StandardModel.leptonSinglet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis
declarations.doc: The charged-lepton-singlet basis diagonalises the `z`-boost.
declarations.statement:
lemma leptonSinglet_repLorentzGroup_boostAxis_two_basis (t : ℝ) (ht : t ≠ 0) (j : Fin 2) :
    LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup (SL2C.boostAxis 2 t ht) (LeptonSinglet.basis j)
      = ((t : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ (weylWeight j) • LeptonSinglet.basis j

modules.title: The gauge-algebra action on the charged-lepton singlet
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

The charged-lepton singlet carries the `(1, 1)_{-6}` representation of the gauge group,
so the infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra is scalar: multiplication by
`i` times `-6` times the `u(1)` value of the algebra element. This file defines that
action and proves it is the infinitesimal action underlying the jet gauge action, in
the sense of `LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf`.

Because the singlet has no colour or weak index, the jet gauge action is multiplication
of the jet-ring factor by the hypercharge phase `(star u) ^ 6`, and both laws of
`IsInfinitesimalActionOf` reduce to scalar identities about the base-point Taylor
coefficients of that phase: the derivative identity `∂ ((star u) ^ 6) =
-(i (-6) ω) (star u) ^ 6` against the `u(1)` value of the Maurer–Cartan form, and the
trivial `u(1)` adjoint equivariance.

## ii. Key results

- `gaugeAlgebraAction` : the infinitesimal `(1, 1)_{-6}` action of the gauge algebra.
- `jetPhase` : the hypercharge phase `(star u) ^ 6` of the jet gauge action.
- `repCoeff_eq` : the base-point Taylor coefficients of the jet gauge action are the
  base-point Taylor coefficients of the hypercharge phase.
- `jetPhase_pderiv` : the derivative identity for the hypercharge phase.
- `isInfinitesimalActionOf` : the gauge-algebra action is the infinitesimal action
  underlying the jet gauge action.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra
- B. The hypercharge phase of the jet gauge action
- C. The Taylor coefficients of the jet gauge action
- D. The derivative identity for the hypercharge phase
- E. The infinitesimal action underlies the jet gauge action
- F. The gauge action commutes with the Lorentz action

## iv. References

* None.

sections.text:
## A. The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra

The `(1, 1)_{-6}` representation acts through the `u(1)` factor alone, so its
derivative is scalar multiplication by `i (-6)` times the `u(1)` value.

## B. The hypercharge phase of the jet gauge action

The jet gauge action multiplies the jet-ring factor by the hypercharge power series
`(star u) ^ 6`: the scalar analogue of the colour matrix of a coloured species.
## C. The Taylor coefficients of the jet gauge action
## D. The derivative identity for the hypercharge phase

## E. The infinitesimal action underlies the jet gauge action

Both laws of `LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf` reduce through `repCoeff_eq` to
scalar identities: the Maurer–Cartan Leibniz law is the all-orders product rule at the
base point applied to the derivative identity, and the adjoint intertwining collapses
because the adjoint action on the `u(1)` component is trivial.
## F. The gauge action commutes with the Lorentz action

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction
declarations.doc:
**The infinitesimal action of the gauge algebra on the charged-lepton singlet**:
the derivative of the `(1, 1)_{-6}` action of the gauge group — scalar
multiplication by `i` times `-6` times the `u(1)` value, real-linear in the algebra
slot and complex-linear in the value slot — the form consumed by
`LocalGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def gaugeAlgebraAction :
    GaugeAlgebra →ₗ[ℝ] LeptonSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonSinglet

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction_apply
declarations.doc:
The gauge-algebra action on the charged-lepton singlet is scalar multiplication
by `i` times `-6` times the `u(1)` value.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_apply (c : GaugeAlgebra) :
    gaugeAlgebraAction c
      = (Complex.I * (-(6 : ℂ) * c.toU1Value))
        • (LinearMap.id : LeptonSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonSinglet)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.jetPhase
declarations.doc:
The `SpaceTimeAlgebra`-valued hypercharge phase of the jet gauge action on the
charged-lepton singlet: the `-6` hypercharge power series `(star u) ^ 6` of the
gauge jet.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def jetPhase (U : JetGaugeGroupI) : SpaceTimeAlgebra

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.jetPhase_eq
declarations.doc: The hypercharge phase, unfolded.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetPhase_eq (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    jetPhase U = (star ((U.2.2 : unitary SpaceTimeAlgebra) : SpaceTimeAlgebra)) ^ 6

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repJetGaugeGroupI_eq_jetPhase
declarations.doc:
The jet gauge action on the charged-lepton singlet is multiplication of the
jet-ring factor by the hypercharge phase.
declarations.statement:
lemma repJetGaugeGroupI_eq_jetPhase (U : JetGaugeGroupI) :
    repJetGaugeGroupI U
      = LinearMap.rTensor LeptonSinglet (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (jetPhase U))

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repCoeff_eq
declarations.doc:
**The base-point Taylor coefficients of the jet gauge action** on the
charged-lepton singlet are scalar: multiplication by the base-point Taylor
coefficients of the hypercharge phase.
declarations.statement:
lemma repCoeff_eq (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (x : Multiset (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3)) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U x
      = constantCoeff (SpaceTimeAlgebra.iteratedPDeriv x (jetPhase U))
        • (LinearMap.id : LeptonSinglet →ₗ[ℂ] LeptonSinglet)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one
declarations.doc:
At the base point, a gauge jet with trivial value acts trivially: the zeroth
Taylor coefficient of the jet gauge action is the identity.
declarations.statement:
lemma repCoeff_zero_of_eval_eq_one {U : JetGaugeGroupI} (hU : U.eval = 1) :
    GaugeAlgebraRealization.repCoeff repJetGaugeGroupI U 0 = LinearMap.id

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.jetPhase_pderiv
declarations.doc:
**The derivative identity** for the hypercharge phase of the jet gauge action: the
formal derivative of the phase is minus `i` times `-6` times the `u(1)` value of the
Maurer–Cartan form, times the phase.
declarations.statement:
lemma jetPhase_pderiv (U : JetGaugeGroupI) (μ : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    pderiv μ (jetPhase U)
      = -(((Complex.I * (-(6 : ℂ))) • (maurerCartanForm U μ).toU1Value)
          * jetPhase U)

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.isInfinitesimalActionOf
declarations.doc:
**The `(1, 1)_{-6}` action of the gauge algebra is the infinitesimal action
underlying the jet gauge action on the charged-lepton singlet**: its base-point
Taylor coefficients obey the Maurer–Cartan Leibniz law and intertwine the action
with the adjoint transports.
declarations.statement:
lemma isInfinitesimalActionOf :
    localGaugeData.IsInfinitesimalActionOf gaugeAlgebraAction repJetGaugeGroupI

declarations.name: StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup
declarations.doc:
The infinitesimal gauge action on the charged-lepton singlet is a scalar, so it
commutes with the Lorentz action.
declarations.statement:
lemma gaugeAlgebraAction_comm_repLorentzGroup (c : GaugeAlgebra) (Λ : SL(2,ℂ))
    (v : LeptonSinglet) :
    LeptonSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction c (LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup Λ v) =
      LeptonSinglet.repLorentzGroup Λ (LeptonSinglet.gaugeAlgebraAction c v)

modules.title: The Standard Model fermions as matter fields
modules.doc:
## i. Overview

`MatterField jets` bundles the value space of one field of a gauge theory over a gauge
context `jets`, its Lorentz representation, the fibrewise action of the jets of gauge
transformations on the jets of the field, its mass weight and its declared statistics. The
five Standard Model fermion types already carry the first four, and this file collects
them, each declared fermionic. Nothing is redefined and no convention is changed. The
chirality, the gauge representation, the hypercharge normalization `6Y` and the
fibrewise-linearity proof are the ones already in the species files.

There is one adapter per fermion type, not per type and generation, since `FermionSpace`
carries `Fin 3` copies of each type and a matter field describes one multiplet.

Mass weight three is the fermionic weight already fixed by
`FermionJetAlgebra.massWeightScale`, in the units in which a derivative has weight two.

## ii. Key results

- `StandardModel.LeptonDoubletV.matterField` : the lepton doublet as a matter field.
- `StandardModel.LeptonSinglet.matterField` : the charged-lepton singlet as a matter field.
- `StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.matterField` : the quark doublet as a matter field.
- `StandardModel.UpSinglet.matterField` : the up-type singlet as a matter field.
- `StandardModel.DownSinglet.matterField` : the down-type singlet as a matter field.

Each comes with the four projection rules `…matterField_V`, `…matterField_repLorentz`,
`…matterField_repJet` and `…matterField_massWeight` identifying its fields with the
existing Standard Model definitions, and with the two conditions
`…matterField_pureJetsActTrivially` and `…matterField_gaugeLorentzCompatible` consumed by
the covariant derivative theory, restated from the species files.

## iii. Table of contents

- A. The lepton sector
  - A.1. The lepton doublet
  - A.2. The charged-lepton singlet
- B. The quark sector
  - B.1. The quark doublet
  - B.2. The up-type singlet
  - B.3. The down-type singlet

## iv. References

* None.
